rows.label: qev018701_MSG0001
rows.name:
Hi there! Thanks for your patronage,
bronze member! Enjoying the Shining
Erudition Hall?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0002
rows.name:
Cash in Miranium and both Mee-mee and
you get lots of money and happiness![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0003
rows.name:
You love money too, don't you? Then
please keep using our services![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_JNK0010
rows.name: Affirmative

rows.label: qev018701_SEL0011
rows.name: Declare that money is more important than life.

rows.label: qev018701_JNK0020
rows.name: Negative

rows.label: qev018701_SEL0021
rows.name: Say you don't have that much attachment to money.

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0004
rows.name:
That's an Earthling for you! You're
every bit as money-mad as the Nopon![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0005
rows.name:
I know! Why not bring me some Aurora Stone
and become a silver member?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0006
rows.name:
Oh! I thought all Earthlings and Nopon
loved money![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0007
rows.name:
But without money, you BLADE members
can't get your equipment in order, can
you?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0008
rows.name:
You can't live on fine words alone! I've
got a delicious offer for you![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0009
rows.name:
Say, why not bring me some Aurora Stone and
become a silver member?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0010
rows.name:
Then your exchange rate goes way up, and
you can make much more money![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0011
rows.name:
Nice! I'm so happy! Please do your best
to get it for me![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0012
rows.name:
With that Aurora Stone, Mee-mee will add
another super alchemy machine...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0013
rows.name: And get even more money than before![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0014
rows.name:
As FrontierNET expands, more and more
Miranium is coming into NLA, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0015
rows.name:
I can't miss this business chance! With
Aurora Stone, I'll add another super alchemy
machine, the Miranium Change...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0016
rows.name: And get even more money than before![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0017
rows.name:
Thanks for your patronage, bronze
member! Welcome to the Shining Erudition
Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0018
rows.name:
Well? Did you get the Aurora Stone? Let's
get that money together![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0019
rows.name:
That's it! With this, I can add one more
super alchemy machine![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0020
rows.name:
Thanks! As of today, you're a silver
member! Your exchange rate goes way, way
up![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0021
rows.name:
Keep cashing in lots of Miranium and
help the Shining Erudition Hall
thrive...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0022
rows.name:
And make Mee-mee the richest person in
NLA![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_JNK0030
rows.name: Affirmative

rows.label: qev018701_SEL0031
rows.name: Laugh and agree to make a profit together.

rows.label: qev018701_JNK0040
rows.name: Negative

rows.label: qev018701_SEL0041
rows.name: State firmly that you have no intention of contributing.

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0023
rows.name:
Yay! Let's build up those savings!
Money's the best![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0024
rows.name:
Well, time is money! Shall I get started
on developing the alchemy machine?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0025
rows.name: Oh my... that's a little sad, but...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018701_MSG0026
rows.name:
Mee-mee wishes you happiness! Cash in
some Miranium whenever you feel like it![ST:wait ]
